premise_summary: The Secret Life of the American Teenager is an American teen drama television series created by Brenda Hampton. It aired on ABC Family from July 1, 2008, to June 3, 2013. It stars Shailene Woodley as Amy Juergens, a teenage girl who becomes pregnant and must navigate relationships between her family and friends as they deal with her unexpected teenage pregnancy and teenage motherhood.
